arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, use seeded daily price histories plus SPY and the stated XLK/XLC benchmarks to describe neutral 21/63-session technical context: dated close, 21/63-session returns where available, relative performance, trend/drawdown and volatility/level risks. Cite evidence IDs and deterministic calculations; do not infer trade execution or forecast direction. Stop with seeded bars.
arguments.decision_impact: Tests whether current price structure and relative performance reinforce or contradict company and macro catalysts, and supplies review-condition context without treating technicals as forecasts.
